# Rehabify

> Rehabify is a physical medicine and rehabilitation (PMR) practice in Bengaluru, India, with video consultations across India. Its doctors are Dr. Dharshan N A, MBBS, MD (Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation), Fellowship in Interventional Pain Management, and Dr. Selina Kh, consultant in physical medicine and rehabilitation. Rehabify looks after back and neck pain, sciatica, joint and sports injuries, stroke, spinal cord and head injury, Parkinson's disease, spasticity, cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, developmental delay, falls and osteoporosis. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 79048 42576.

Information on this site is for general education and does not replace a consultation. Medical emergency in India: call 108 or 112.

## Care
- [Pain and spine](https://www.rehabify.in/pain-and-spine/): back pain, neck pain, sciatica, image-guided injections and nerve blocks
- [Neuro rehabilitation](https://www.rehabify.in/neuro-rehabilitation/): stroke, spinal cord injury, head injury, Parkinson's disease, spasticity
- [Joints and sports](https://www.rehabify.in/joints-and-sports/): knee pain, shoulder pain, sports injuries, after fracture or surgery, PRP and prolotherapy, prosthetic rehab
- [Children's rehabilitation](https://www.rehabify.in/childrens-rehabilitation/): cerebral palsy, muscular dystrophy, developmental delay
- [Older adults](https://www.rehabify.in/older-adults/): falls and balance, osteoporosis
- [Conditions A to Z](https://www.rehabify.in/conditions/)
